name: Korean Mewtwo Sealed Battle HR winner prize
short: Korean Mewtwo Sealed Battle HR winner prize

description.text: The winner's prize of the Mewtwo HR sealed battles, the Mewtwo sealed battles played with the enhanced expansion pack Remix Bout, in which each player opened ten packs on site and built a 40-card deck: a rainbow Mewtwo-GX 173/SM-P in HR style, of which only 17 were made. The battles were held at Pokémon Korea's headquarters on 19 October 2019 and at authorized card shops from 22 October to 6 November 2019.
